🚨🇨🇳 | CHINA TESTS COUGH-TRACKING SYSTEM

China’s CDC is piloting a system to monitor mysterious pneumonia as respiratory diseases surge, including human metapneumovirus cases in children. Experts warn against overusing antivirals for the virus, which mimics a cold.
